title: Late Bedtime Sleep Efficiency Drop
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), WHOOP recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body and blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, WHOOP, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:daily bedtime_hour>=23
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(sleep_efficiency_pct) as avg_efficiency, avg(restfulness_score) as avg_restfulness by user _time
| where avg_efficiency<85
| sort avg_efficiency
description: Looks specifically at late-bedtime nights and shows when they are consistently producing poor sleep efficiency rather than simply later mornings.
value: It is easier to change a habit when the cost is visible; this query makes the penalty of 'just one more hour awake' hard to ignore.
implementation: Forward bedtime and efficiency fields from Oura; review weekly and compare late-night weeks against your normal sleep quality.
visualization: Weekly chart of sleep efficiency for late-bedtime nights.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much your sleep quality drops on the weeks when you keep going to bed very late.
